definitions.gloss: many rebirths across past and future lives
definitions.explanation: A Buddhist concept referring to the many lifetimes a soul passes through in the cycle of rebirth. Used almost exclusively in the proverb {袖|そで}{振|ふ}り{合|あ}うも{多生|たしょう}の{縁|えん}.

examples.japanese: {多生|たしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a karmic connection from past lives.
They say even a brush of sleeves is a karmic bond from past lives.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多生|たしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Even though we seem to have met by chance, perhaps there is actually a karmic tie from past lives.

notes:
Almost never used outside the Buddhist proverb below. The word literally means "many births" — the soul being reborn many times across lifetimes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧{振|ふ}り{合|あ}う⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{多生|たしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧: Even brushing sleeves with a stranger is the result of a karmic bond from past lives — used to suggest that no encounter is truly random.

USAGE:
- Sometimes written {他生|たしょう} with the same meaning; both forms appear in the proverb.
- Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{多少|たしょう}→多少：01647_tashou⟧ (somewhat; a little).
